title: Do the Right Thing, Just Debias! Multi-Category Bias Mitigation Using LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Mitigation of social biases and stereotypes in religious contexts. Specifically, the task is to transform a biased sentence related to a religious group into a neutral one while preserving the original meaning.
findings: The paper finds that its newly proposed ANUBIS dataset, which includes religion as one of nine bias categories, is effective for training models in bias mitigation. Specifically, an SFT model trained on ANUBIS outperformed a model trained on the WIKIBIAS dataset in mitigating religious bias on the ANUBIS test set, achieving higher METEOR (18.03 vs 13.78) and BERTScore (89.58 vs 88.7) scores.
